inherited_release_gate.note: Dev7 changes GMX matrix-animation timing, glTF animation key timing, explicit camera/field animation exporters, tests, tables and docs. Direct package extraction, audio/SDAT, procedural route/camera, viewers and prior real-package gates remain inherited from frozen checkpoints.

limitations: Exact global DAT/opcode activation schedules for animated camera and field modes remain unresolved; the new exporters require explicit GMX inputs.
cam02_op1 contains 300 matrix samples per track, but the traced camera controller only reaches frames 0..199; possible use of samples 200..299 by another path remains unresolved.
Field-model animation can be externally frame-driven; dev7 exports descriptor-frame evaluation but does not infer the complete stage driver timeline.
Runtime fog-profile selection over time remains unresolved.
Camera preset word 11 remains a proven shared model/material scalar with unresolved exact virtual-setter meaning.
Instruction-level RSX/Xenos shader disassembly/translation remains future work.
The bundled Blender add-on has not been exercised inside a real Blender UI/runtime.
The project owner has not selected a license for original toolkit code.
